baseline: canonical v59, same candidate code with profile=1&terrainCache=off
parityGate: entire RGBA32F target packed raw bytes equal to forced fresh draw; cached entry valid; exact native PNG equality for fixed-state on/off, original known hash when available
controls: worker native full target and PNG
light transition continues misses until settled

performanceGate.camera: same fixed seed74 terrain pose rain; paused cloud state for causal ABA, animation still full compute path
performanceGate.adopt: B submission and completed-prefix rates exceed both A windows, improvement over mean A exceeds relative A1/A2 drift; all prefixes complete, no parity difference
performanceGate.motionControl: full native orbit moving, cache on; verify no hits and inspect CPU/key overhead against disabled moving control; no stable60 or presented FPS claim from these runs

stop: Any unexplained pixel/Float32 difference blocks measurement/adoption until fixed. Measured benefit must exceed drift; otherwise keep canonical runtime.
